Subject: Post-call notes: SIG Q&A + evidence plan (Mar 5)

All — thanks for the call today. Quick notes and action items (summarized from our 30m discussion):

Meeting summary:
- Confirmed SIG modules in scope: Data Security, Infrastructure & Virtualization, Access Control, and Vendor Management.
- SOC 2 scope: platform control plane, hosted API, telemetry pipeline for inference logs; Dedicated/Private customer-managed infra excluded (per our SOC2 annex). Attached: one-page SOC2 scope summary.
- Key clarifications:
  - Onboarding: customer onboarding checks include SSO enablement, background checks for ops, and contractually defined data handling.
  - KMS: customer data-at-rest is encrypted with provider-managed keys in hosted deployments; we support BYOK for Dedicated/Private. Root key rotation cadence: annually (rotation is coordinated with KMS provider).
  - Retention: inference logs retained by default 30 days; exportable on request. Long-term retention can be configured for Dedicated customers.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Diego: Share SOC2 scope one-pager and named evidence examples — due Fri Mar 6 EOD. [attachment: SOC2-scope-summary-2025.pdf]
- Monica: Provide example access review CSV and pointer to audit-log excerpts — due Mon Mar 9.
- Elena/Security: Confirm any additional SIG control clarifications and provide prioritized evidence list — due Wed Mar 11.

Requested evidence list (initial):
- Access reviews (named file example: access-review-YYYYMM-DD.csv)
- SOC2 report excerpt for relevant controls (attestation pages + scope)
- KMS configuration snapshot (redacted)
- Onboarding checklist template (onboarding-checklist.pdf)
- Inference logs retention policy (retention-policy-v1.pdf)

Next steps:
- Diego will upload the prep pack + SOC2 scope to shared Drive folder and link the HubSpot deal record.
- We’ll reconvene if auditors request further detail; otherwise Novasol will start collecting artifacts per the naming convention above.

If anything above looks off, flag it here and I’ll update. Thanks again — good productive session.

Best regards,
